summary.text: Nathan Berning, a nonpartisan candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Hawaii's 1st District to Ed Case, receiving 1.3% of the vote to Case's 71.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He had advanced from the August 8, 2026 nonpartisan primary, in which he ran unopposed and received 877 votes.
Little biographical information is publicly available, and he has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
